redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/prescan-containers.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: Added scripts/lib/prescan/containers.mjs (hand-written block/flow YAML subset reader; compose services: image or build context+dockerfile resolved repo-relative, ports {host,container,protocol}, volumes, dependsOn, envKeys by name only incl. env_file key names; Dockerfiles: final-stage base, stages, EXPOSE ports, ENTRYPOINT+CMD command, entrypoint file; evidence {path,lines}; sort by path/line; MAX_ITEMS 20000 per kind with truncated counts, MAX_NESTED 2000; skipped counts for alias/merge services and FROM-less Dockerfiles; no code execution) and the one-line stacks/containers.mjs re-export. Wrote skills/architecture-map/references/stack-containers.md in the shape of stack-ts-frontend.md. Fixture tests/fixtures/repos/containers: docker-compose.yml (web, api, db), web/Dockerfile (multi-stage), api/Dockerfile; git add -N applied. tests/prescan-containers.test.mjs: 8 cases ct1..ct8. First run was red (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for containers.mjs, before implementation), then 8/8 green. Full `node --test`: 531 pass, 0 fail. Two adjacent files outside the declared files had to change and the plan gate allowed both edits: skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md (one table row linking stack-containers.md, required by s2 'every reference is linked') and tests/prescan-core.test.mjs pc2 (expected stacks now include 'containers' because the MIXED fixture holds api/Dockerfile). BLOCKED: the fixture's .env.example could not be created - Write on tests/fixtures/repos/containers/.env.example was refused ('File is in a directory that is denied by your permission settings'); I did not work around it via Bash. Consequence: the fixture has no .env.example (the compose file has no env_file line so nothing depends on it); env_file key-name reading is covered in-memory by ct3. Also a python heredoc edit via Bash was refused by the auto-mode classifier; I redid it with the Edit tool. Dependants: tests/fixtures/repos/containers is a new directory, so the 'basename' dependants (generic.mjs, partition.mjs, merge.mjs, prescan.mjs, golden model, merge/prescan-core tests, discovery-generic.md) name the word 'containers' generically, not this path, and the full suite is green, so they are still correct; the other three files have no dependants.
outcome.descriptive: Prescan now extracts compose services and Dockerfiles (ports, volumes, depends_on, env names, entrypoint) with file:line evidence, behind a stack reference and a fixture, at no cost to the agent prompts.
